letters.subject: Invoice DVF-55187: change of bank details to confirm by phone
letters.body:
Hello Nia,

We have received invoice DVF-55187 dated 21 October 2026 for £891.36. The bank details on it (sort code 00-98-76, account ending 1234) are different from the ones we hold for you (sort code 00-14-27, account ending 1184).

Before any payment is made, we will phone you on the number we already have on file to confirm the change. We never change bank details because of an email, so please don't send bank details by reply. If you have not changed banks, please let us know straight away.

Kind regards,
Office Administrator
Demo Fixings Ltd

letters.subject: Invoice PTS-6604: total does not add up
letters.body:
Hello Elin,

Thank you for invoice PTS-6604 dated 26 October 2026. The net of £948.00 plus VAT of £189.60 comes to £1,137.60, but the total shown is £1,152.60, a difference of £15.00.

Could you send a corrected invoice, please? A reply by Monday 9 November would be appreciated.

Kind regards,
Office Administrator
Demo Fixings Ltd

letters.subject: Invoice RSW-2208: purchase order number needed

Hello,

Thank you for invoice RSW-2208 dated 27 October 2026 for £667.20. It doesn't quote a purchase order number, and we can't match it to one of our orders by supplier and amount.

Could you let us know which order it is for by Monday 9 November?

Kind regards,
Office Administrator
Demo Fixings Ltd
